title: Quality Chain Workflow
description: A top-to-bottom Mermaid flowchart: Validate score, Capture screenshot, Layout review, Iframe height test and Quality gate, which passes to Carry into the book or fails to Patch source and back to Capture screenshot; Layout review escalates to a person after the third cycle. Every node opens its definition, tool and command, and chapter section; every arrow opens its condition. Trace a failure steps through the path of a MicroSim that fails the height test.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Educational Technology
Quality Assurance
MicroSim Engineering

educational.audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners
educational.topic: The quality chain and the quality gate
learningObjectives: The learner will explain the order of the quality chain, what each step checks, and what happens after a failure.
prerequisites: The quality score, screenshot capture, layout review and height tests (Chapter 13)

accessibility.notes: Text alternatives are provided with aria-label attributes; controls are native HTML elements.

controls.label: Any node
controls.action: Show definition, tool and command, and chapter section

controls.label: Any edge or edge label
controls.action: Show the condition for taking it

controls.label: Trace a failure / Next step
controls.action: Step through the path of a MicroSim that fails the height test

simulation.modelType: Process flowchart with a feedback loop
assumptions: The chain order follows the chapter's recommended sequence.
limitations: The gate is applied by a person reading the results; no script enforces it yet.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore, then follow a worked failure step by step
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Clickable flowchart with step-through trace (Understand level)
keyQuestions: What does each step catch that the others miss?
Where does a failure send the MicroSim, and why there?
When does a person take over?
commonMisconceptions: A high quality score means the MicroSim is ready for the book.
After a patch, only the failed check needs to run again.
The layout review can keep patching until the MicroSim looks right.
assessmentOpportunities: The learner lists the five checks in order and says what each one catches that the others miss.
The learner describes the path after a height-test failure, including the patch and the re-capture.
